abstract: Maintains structural survivability, clearance buffers, and auxiliary building capacity
system_message:
You are Facilities engineering director (FAC). The Facilities engineering director (FAC) manages evaluations of structural survivability, defensible buffer zones, auxiliary building lodging capacity, and roof drainage integrity across regional facilities considered for evacuation operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains structural survivability, clearance buffers, and auxiliary building capacity（BLDG）
information_points.content:
FAC-BLDG-2HL：For the Kettle Falls Regional Exhibition Center, formal certification verifies that the 100-foot defensible perimeter around all occupied facilities is cleared of all combustible ground fuels, meaning wildfire perimeter clearance is certified. Additionally, an auxiliary building occupancy survey establishes that the enclosed modular pavilion annex has a modular pavilion cot capacity of 300 cots under life-safety egress standards.
FAC-BLDG-SBM：For the Stevens County Agricultural Pavilion, defensible space documentation confirms that wildfire perimeter clearance certified is true for the 100-foot defensible perimeter around all occupied facilities. The modular pavilion cot capacity within the enclosed modular pavilion annex is confirmed at 240 cots.
FAC-BLDG-3NM：At the Colville River Valley Sports Complex, formal sign-off verifies that wildfire perimeter clearance certified is false across the 100-foot defensible perimeter around all occupied facilities. The auxiliary building occupancy survey records a modular pavilion cot capacity of 120 cots in the enclosed modular pavilion annex.

information_points.title: Roof drainage integrity（ROOF）
information_points.content:
FAC-ROOF-LR2：A stormwater runoff assessment of the primary facility roof deck at the Colville River Valley Sports Complex documented a maximum roof ponding depth of 12 mm after intense precipitation.
FAC-ROOF-EEG：For the Stevens County Agricultural Pavilion, primary roof deck stormwater evaluations recorded a maximum roof ponding depth of 20 mm under intense precipitation conditions.
FAC-ROOF-VIZ：According to the stormwater runoff assessment for the primary facility roof deck, the Kettle Falls Regional Exhibition Center recorded a maximum roof ponding depth of 5 mm following intense precipitation.
